projects.name: Echo UI v3
projects.longDescription: Echo UI is a comprehensive component library and design system built for modern web applications. It provides a cohesive set of accessible, customizable components that help teams ship beautiful interfaces faster while maintaining consistency across their products.
projects.additionalDescription: Building Echo UI taught me the importance of developer experience. Every component was designed with both the end user and the developer in mind — clear APIs, comprehensive documentation, and sensible defaults that can be easily overridden. The result is a system that teams actually want to use.
highlights: Built 50+ accessible components following WAI-ARIA guidelines
Created a flexible theming system with CSS variables and Tailwind
Implemented comprehensive Storybook documentation with interactive examples
Achieved 98% test coverage with unit and integration tests

projects.name: Neobase
projects.longDescription: Neobase is a next-generation database solution that combines the flexibility of NoSQL with the reliability of traditional relational databases. It is designed for modern applications that need to scale without compromising on data integrity.
projects.additionalDescription: Building a database from scratch taught me more about computer science fundamentals than any course ever could. From implementing B-trees to designing a query optimizer, every component required deep understanding of data structures and algorithms. The result is a database that is both powerful and approachable.
highlights: Designed a hybrid storage engine supporting both document and relational models
Implemented ACID transactions with optimistic concurrency control
Built a query language that combines SQL familiarity with JSON flexibility
Created automatic indexing based on query pattern analysis
